about_the_game:
BREAKING NEWS: The Ultimate Strategy Card Game for Grad School Warriors — Graduate Battle — is Here! 

Studying 24/7 still not enough?
Memorizing words even in your sleep feels slow?
Don’t worry — now you can learn while playing cards!

Grad Students + Card Masters = Unstoppable Power Surge!
Graduate Battle is tailor-made for students preparing for China’s graduate entrance exams.
Every duel is a vocabulary showdown — no more flipping through wordbooks mid-game.
Review, reinforce, and expand your vocab while enjoying intense, strategic battles!

Brand-New Strategic Gameplay — Academic Combat Begins Now!
Face off against challenging word cards, use character skills, manage your research funds ($) and academic ability to level up, and conquer harder battles!
Each character has unique traits — build the perfect team to dominate the scholarly battlefield!

Hardcore Word Bank — Laser-Focused on Common Exam Traps!
Our in-game vocabulary is sourced from a premium 2026 Chinese grad exam word list,
featuring commonly confused terms that often trip up test takers.
No more falling for tricky word pairs — every battle makes you smarter!

Designed for Chinese exams, playable by everyone!
Even if you're not preparing for China’s exams, you can still enjoy the game —
whether it's for sharpening your English vocab, exploring clever strategy gameplay,
or just experiencing a unique academic-themed card game. No language barrier, just pure fun and learning!

How to Level Up Your Exam Prep with Graduate Battle
✔ Study during the day, play at night — review vocab effortlessly!
✔ Don’t recognize a word? Click to learn it, then add it to your vocab app!
✔ Card game lover and exam warrior? This game is your secret weapon!

Join the Fight Today!
The exam battlefield has officially opened —
Can you survive the ultimate academic showdown?
Download now and become a true Scholar of War!
